verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes its own OpenAPI spec for the Cloud API (cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json), and a rendered API reference at docs-api.lambda.ai lists endpoints such as 'List workspaces / Create workspace'. That shows a structured API reference exists, but nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. The probe 404s only cover docs.lambda.ai paths, so they do not contradict the published spec. Missing for 10: evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request consoles, code samples per endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
